description:
I totally forgot to mention this in the video: 3 sets of 5 seconds per side.

This is how I superset them with my team:

Monday
Straight punch ISO holds + Pallof ISO holds

Wednesday
Banded hook ISO holds + split-stance drive ISO holds

Friday
Hip thrust ISO holds + floor press ISO holds

Again, 3 sets × 5 seconds per side.
Don't do more than that. It's unnecessary.

The whole point is to get as much motor unit recruitment as possible during those 5 seconds. Quality > quantity.

Comment if you're going to try these out or want a deeper breakdown.
